seed: Objects of type `player` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [wall] show mixed outcomes: x x2, no_change x2. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Floor colour 5 read from frame; any other colour blocks moves; rows 0/63 reserved for HUD.
Blocks (colour 10): A1/A2 both y-/+4, A3 apart, A4 together, each independently iff dest all floor (the A4 mixed outcome = blocked destination, not an object field).
Click colour 9 marker arms (blocks->1, marker->11, previous active->9); click colour 1 disarms; other clicks and A5 are no-ops.
Armed: arrows move the active 2x2 marker by 4 iff its bbox grown by 1 is floor.
HUD bar w=3(a+1)//7 zeros (row 0 right, row 63 left); a hidden, continuity-gated, fallback a=0 without bar else max a for width.
